tasks.objective: 电池热管理与功率请求跟踪. 在高环境温度和持续功率请求下，控制器应通过冷却与功率降额将电池核心温度限制在安全范围内，同时保持SOC与电压合理。. Scenario time window 0s to 1200s; inputs: ambient_temp_C, driver_power_request_W_profil

constraint_set.source_text: 电池热管理与功率请求跟踪. 在高环境温度和持续功率请求下，控制器应通过冷却与功率降额将电池核心温度限制在安全范围内，同时保持SOC与电压合理。. Scenario time window 0s to 1200s; inputs: ambient_temp_C, driver_power_request_W_profile; initial conditions: T_core_C, T_surface_C, coolant_temp_C, soc. Acceptance criteria: max(T_core_C) <= 55.0; min(soc) >= 0.2; within_range(voltage_V) in [280.0, 420.0]; within_range(pump_cmd) in [0.0, 1.0]; within_range(fan_cmd) in [0.0, 1.0]. Signals of interest: driver_power_request_W, current_A, voltage_V, soc, T_core_C, T_surface_C, coolant_in_temp_C, coolant_flow_kgps, pump_cmd, fan_cmd Verification should conclude pass only when the co-simulation runs to completion and satisfies every acceptance criterion on the monitored signals.

selected_fmus.name: ThermalController
selected_fmus.description: Supervisory thermal controller for battery pack. Tracks driver power request but derates based on SOC, voltage, and core temperature. Commands battery current, pump and fan. Includes integral action and hysteresis mode switching.

ports.name: driver_power_request_W
ports.description: Requested traction electrical power from driver (positive demand).

ports.name: I_min_A
ports.description: Minimum discharge current command (no regen in this scenario).

ports.name: soc_min
ports.description: SOC lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: V_min_V
ports.description: Voltage lower limit for allowing power.

ports.name: kP_current
ports.description: Proportional gain mapping requested power to current via I=P/V * kP_current.

ports.name: ambient_ff_gain
ports.description: Ambient temperature feedforward for cooling (more cooling at high ambient).
